units.rawText: I know that you are the mainstay of the Oasis and don't always have time for proper meals, but all this fast food may be a bit too crude...
units.displayText: I know that you are the mainstay of the Oasis and don't always have time for proper meals, but all this fast food may be a bit too crude...

spans.text: I know that you are the mainstay of the Oasis and don't always have time for proper meals, but all this fast food may be a bit too crude...

units.rawText: I can't bear to watch you eat your meals so perfunctorily. Not only are you being irresponsible to your health, you are also disrespecting food.
units.displayText: I can't bear to watch you eat your meals so perfunctorily. Not only are you being irresponsible to your health, you are also disrespecting food.

spans.text: I can't bear to watch you eat your meals so perfunctorily. Not only are you being irresponsible to your health, you are also disrespecting food.

units.rawText: If you are too busy, I will prepare food that can keep for a while for you. This can't go on any longer.
units.displayText: If you are too busy, I will prepare food that can keep for a while for you. This can't go on any longer.

spans.text: If you are too busy, I will prepare food that can keep for a while for you. This can't go on any longer.

units.rawText: ... So, what do you say? You really should take better care of yourself. Many rely on you in the Oasis.
